identity.notes: The official Kensington page, branded exact-address Menufy storefront, and active Uber Eats store all bind this record to 10534 Connecticut Ave and phone (240) 833-2917. The official page lists daily 11 a.m.-midnight service.

sources.excerpt: Official exact-location page identifies Crisp & Juicy Kensington at 10534 Connecticut Ave, Kensington, MD 20895, phone (240) 833-2917, daily hours, and direct retail and catering ordering links.

Official-linked Owner storefront was selected for pickup at 10534 Connecticut Ave. All 68 labels were inspected; 67 are food or nonalcoholic products and To Go Bag is a nonfood charge. Descriptions support limited direct positive allergen claims but no matrix.

Official site-linked Owner catering menu lists Kensington at 10534 Connecticut Ave as an ordering location. All 35 current catering products were inspected. Category notes ask customers to report allergies and promise best-efforts accommodation, but do not provide product mappings or a cross-contact policy.

Active branded Menufy storefront is bound to Crisp & Juicy at 10534 Connecticut Ave and exposes 63 labels, consolidated to 61 canonical Kensington products. It corroborates Black Beans and Inca Cola beyond the current retail Owner page.

Active exact-address Uber Eats storefront confirms 10534 Connecticut Ave, phone (240) 833-2917, current delivery hours, and the same Kensington-only retail boundary including Black Beans and Inka Kola.
Fresh official-domain searches for allergen, allergy, ingredients, nutrition, PDF, and cross-contact resources found no restaurant-issued allergen document.
Exact-brand and Kensington-targeted searches corroborated the official and exact-address ordering surfaces but found no authoritative item-by-allergen matrix or cross-contact policy.

findings.summary: Official and exact-address ordering surfaces confirm the current Kensington operation at 10534 Connecticut Ave and distinguish it from Silver Spring and Washington siblings.
The complete current Kensington retail, catering, and nonalcoholic boundary contains 93 canonical products. Eight current beverages/sides were missing from the frozen 104-row aggregation.

Thirteen side-plus-soda or extra-sauce rows are absent from every complete Kensington surface and are location mismatches; All White Meat, generic Large/Medium, and To Go Bag are modifier/nonfood parser artifacts.
Retail/catering spelling or number variants for Alfajor/Alfajores and Crisp/Crispy & Juicy Salad represent two stable products, not four separate products.

No comprehensive item-by-allergen matrix or cross-contact policy was found after all four required searches. The catering allergy-request note is best-efforts accommodation guidance only; direct claims remain limited to named ingredients and product identity.
